news.q: Jahmyr Gibbs ran for three touchdowns in the Lions' 39-35 Thanksgiving loss to the Bears on Nov. 26. How many rushing yards did he have?
news.fact: He did it on just 21 carries, including a 70-yard score.

news.q: The comedy Focker-in-Law opened the day before Thanksgiving. To the nearest million, how many million dollars did it earn on Thanksgiving Day, by studio estimates?
news.fact: Studios estimated a $7.7 million Thursday on the way to a $40 million five-day opening.

easy.q: In what year did the Soviet Union launch Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite?
easy.fact: It was about the size of a beach ball and circled Earth every 96 minutes.

easy.q: How many different actors have played Peter Parker as Spider-Man in live-action movies?
easy.fact: Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield and Tom Holland all appear in 2021's No Way Home.

easy.q: Japan is made up of how many main islands?
easy.fact: Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu and Shikoku are the four main islands.

easy.q: To the nearest mile, how long is a 5K race?
How many strings does a standard violin have?
easy.fact: Its strings are tuned G, D, A and E.

medium.q: How many years did Alcatraz operate as a federal prison?
medium.fact: It closed in 1963 because it had become too costly to run.

medium.q: How many Grammys did Kendrick Lamar's "Not Like Us" win at the 2025 ceremony?
medium.fact: It won both Record and Song of the Year.

medium.q: In what year did the Sydney Opera House open?
medium.fact: It became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2007.

medium.q: How many Formula 1 world championships has Max Verstappen won?
medium.fact: He won four in a row, from 2021 through 2024.

medium.q: Work on England's Stonehenge began about how many thousand years ago?
medium.fact: Its largest sarsen stones weigh about 25 tons each.

hard.q: How many days did the World War II siege of Leningrad last?
hard.fact: The city is now called St. Petersburg again.

hard.q: How many tracks are on Drake's 2018 double album Scorpion?
hard.fact: It topped a billion streams worldwide in its first week.

hard.q: How tall is Washington's Mount St. Helens today, in feet?
hard.fact: Its 1980 eruption knocked about 1,300 feet off the top.

hard.q: To the nearest foot, how far was Bob Beamon's famous long jump at the 1968 Olympics?
hard.fact: It beat the world record by nearly 2 feet and stood for almost 23 years.
